classification: Posthoc extension after seven signal candidates failed dual-year objective
scope: Independent implementation of selected Alpha158-style OHLCV feature families; not the full Alpha158 dataset or its published benchmark
training: Past at most 60 mature monthly dates, minimum 36; all stock labels in a training date must have exited by decision date
target: Same-date percentile rank of saved next-open-to-next-open monthly return
hyperparameters: Reuse V1.6 Ridge alpha=100 and fixed LGBM 160 trees, depth5, 15 leaves, learning rate0.03, min100, lambda20, seed42; no tuning
portfolio: Unchanged E2, Buffer30/60 equal weights, 1m CNY, 5bp base
stress: Both candidates 15bp and 10m capital, same opened interval
stop: Two model candidates only; preserve both outcomes and do not declare independent final-test success
